column1: # memfn/data/cards/kit-kernels.tsv — THE STANDALONE KERNELS' METHOD CARDS,
# `kit-kernels@N` (R-MS5; docs/design/measure_sets.md §7.2; the standing rule
# "a new method adds its measurement card in the same change", D176,
# docs/dev/guide/addenda/kit.md). One row per (owner, quantity, ver),
# APPEND-ONLY by version: a committed row never changes.
# ver 1 (lane simdset, 2026-10-29): `mf_kernel_find_any` (memfn/src/vany.c),
# "find any of K bytes", K 2..3, NOT ROUTED. Its forms, the `form` token of
# every key below (`kit.<quantity>.<form>...`):
#   vany2-w16 vany2-w32 vany3-w16 vany3-w32   the per-level helpers, K 2 / 3
#   vany2-body vany3-body                     the portable body (the byte loop)
# and the comparators a `vs` token names: those forms, WALK (the kit's walk,
# u's own form) and LIBC (one `memchr` per member, the scalar layer's libc
# arm). The quantities and dims are kit-grid@1's, so a set measured under
# this card uses the keys the finder's readers already spell.
# UNMEASURED. No committed set (measure_store/, memfn/data/sets/) holds a
# `kit.*.vany*` row and no box has run this card: every reader skips an absent
# key (docs/spec/measures.md §0¶2), so nothing is priced by a guess. The first
# run that measures it writes the rows; until then they read UNMEASURED.
# `deps` name kit:form.<form>; the kernel renders outside any site, so
# mf_form_hash cannot hash it yet: the deps are OWED (simdset_report.md, open
# question 2), as tests/memfn/run_finder.sh lists an unresolved dep.
# `gate_e6` is kit-grid@1's 30000, an UNMEASURED DEFAULT (D149) as there.
# Columns (measure_sets.md §7.2): owner quantity ver dims unit subject
# lengths launches rounds aa_rule gate_e6 env deps.
